adaptation_measures: Coordinate field validation with MAO/AEWs before public release.
Prioritize advisories for vulnerable rainfed and smallholder production areas.
Document farm impacts for DA and PCIC support where losses are observed.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Santa Maria: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. ACAP calendar anchor: Jul 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Vegetative / Active tillering; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Leaf development. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.
texts.sms: DA OPS: Defer open-air grain drying in Santa Maria. High humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. Check MAO guidance.
texts.lgu:
OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Santa Maria
Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
Why defer: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable.
ACAP calendar: Jul 1-15 - Rice season 2 - Vegetative / Active tillering; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Leaf development.
LGU/MAO action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available; inform affected barangays and reschedule support services.
texts.facebook: Operations Advisory - Defer Open-Air Grain Drying - Santa Maria: Please defer sun-drying of palay or corn grain for now. Reason: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk. Current crop calendar basis: Rice season 2 - Vegetative / Active tillering; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Leaf development. Coordinate with your Municipal Agriculturist for the next safe field window.

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.
Increase pest and disease scouting for fungal and bacterial disease triggers.
Use resistant varieties and integrated pest management; spray only during safe weather windows.

texts.bulletin: WET SPELL DISEASE WATCH - Santa Maria: 25 consecutive wet days and high humidity may favor fungal/bacterial diseases. Increase field scouting for rice blast/sheath blight and corn fungal diseases. Spray only when rain and wind conditions are safe.
texts.sms: DA WATCH: Wet/humid days in Santa Maria. Scout crops for disease; spray only in clear, low-wind weather.
texts.lgu:
DISEASE WATCH - Santa Maria
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - Santa Maria: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.
